title: Walks that fail in the full sweep
goal: The scripted walks are the app driving itself, and some of them no longer reach what they were written to check. Find out what each failing walk is looking for, then either fix the app if the walk is right or update the walk if the app moved on. This serves the focus because the sweep is the only thing that tells a focus runner whether the change it just made broke anything: a sweep with failures nobody has named cannot say that, so every focus feature ships on a weaker claim than it should.

DIAGNOSIS from the digest pass, 2026-09-22. Nine of the fifteen are ONE cause, not nine. Reproduced: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/size-limits-walk.json --no-build -> step 14 (reveal): no control called "Limits" in "Width" is in the panel. That walk's own panel dump (/tmp/photonz-playtest/size-limits/panel-1-arrives.json) shows the Layout section IS on screen and open, and holds exactly two things: 'Room answer (More room moves the pieces in from the edges.)' and 'Background'. No Width row, no Height row, no Limits twist, no padding. Cause: 1beb145e, 'Dragging a component hands you a copy, not the original'. Every drag now puts down a COPY, and a copy is configured rather than authored, so it gets the two-row placed-component panel instead of the authoring wall. These walks all drag a starter component and then click the thing that landed, which used to be the original. The walks are what moved, not the app. The nine: button-hug-walk (Padding), clip-contents-walk, container-too-small-walk, out-of-view-mark-walk, refused-width-says-why-walk, size-limits-walk, width-reads-back-walk (all Limits in Width/Height), layout-fits-walk (Each side), and copies-share-choice-walk plus copy-own-color-walk (Related in Swatches, same copy-versus-original shape). Fix is one decision applied nine times: have each walk reach the ORIGINAL that the drop now brings in beside the copy, or detach the copy first, whichever matches what the walk is really checking. Do that one first and the list should drop to five.

The remaining five, each on its own: history-thumbnail-shapes-walk is not an app fault at all, its setup refuses because 'Shape 1 wide 2400x300.png' is already sitting in ~/Pictures/Screenshots from an earlier run, so a walk is leaving its lent fixture behind on the real machine; move it aside and also find what fails to put it back. find-what-stayed-a-picture-walk says the row 'Text 8' is in the panel when the step says it should not be. dock-picked-first-walk times out on sectionInView("Appearance") and is the same complaint as the open task appearance-is-below-the-fold-again-because-the-p, so read that one before touching it. tutorial-start-on-an-icon-frame-walk times out on tutorialStep("what-the-frame-knows"). delete-key-drops-a-piece-walk has been taken out of this task into its own, delete-stops-dropping-a-piece-once-you-have-undo, because it is a real bug in the focus feature rather than a walk that needs correcting.
